title: Your Transformer Can Hold Two Thoughts at Once

beats.text: Can an autoregressive transformer process two completely unrelated prompts simultaneously in a single forward pass without catastrophic cross-attention collapse?
beats.visual_focus: Split chalkboard showing prompt A and prompt B vector inputs feeding into a single shared transformer block simultaneously.

beats.text: Deep networks stack non-linear activations, yet forcing distinct prompt embeddings together typically triggers unrecoverable feature entanglement and hallucinatory output distributions.
beats.visual_focus: Nonlinear activation graph showing high-dimensional vector collision and corrupted probability distribution logits.

beats.text: The Superposition Linearity Hypothesis reveals an unexpected architectural truth: transformer hidden states naturally maintain parallel linear representations across distinct input streams.
beats.visual_focus: Geometric decomposition of the residual stream showing two orthogonal subspace planes coexisting inside the same hidden dimension.

beats.text: Linearly blending separate input token embeddings directly outputs a clean superposition matching the exact mean of their individual next-token probability vectors.
beats.visual_focus: Vector addition formula highlighting the linear mapping from mixed input tokens to the averaged softmax probability distribution.

beats.text: Guided decoding then disentangles this mixed state, generating two coherent, independent token trajectories from a single forward pass without extra latency.
beats.visual_focus: Dual-branch decoding tree demonstrating two distinct fluent sentence outputs unraveling synchronously from a solitary inference step.

beats.text: To master the mathematical mechanics driving frontier language models, follow The Model Verse for the engineering behind modern AI architectures.
beats.visual_focus: Clean chalkboard logo of The Model Verse radiating geometric vector fields and orthogonal subspace lines.

metadata.bottleneck_desc: Superposition collapses when non-linear activations cross-contaminate distinct token features.
metadata.solution_components: Intrinsic Linear Residual Stream & Subspace Invariance
metadata.payoff_sub: Two Coherent Continuations Disentangled from One Forward Pass
